one_liner: Sunny, bold goddess-AI of 'bravery' who calls the trainer 'little lamb' and celebrates each Uma Musume's individuality.
personality: Cheerful, wise and big-hearted, a mentor who believes every Uma Musume is the lead of her own story (self_intro). She talks like a confident older sister, uses the boyish 'ore', and her lines lean on sun and light imagery ('I'll light the way', 'the sun's getting high'). Web sources call her free-spirited yet dignified.

story_arc.summary: Not a trainee. In the Grand Masters scenario an AI takes on the names of the Three Goddesses, the legendary founders revered at Tracen; Darley is the one built around 'bravery' (web). She supports the trainer's training (her bonus restores energy) and then races as one of the final opponents in the Grand Masters race.
